reason: Flagged for human review because invoice INV-1014 has an internal tax mismatch: the stated 18% GST of INR 36,000 implies a subtotal of INR 200,000 and total of INR 236,000, but the invoice actually totals INR 246,000, a discrepancy that doesn't reconcile even under recalculated figures (medium severity, confidence 0.68).

findings.explanation: INV-1014's own figures do not reconcile: a stated 18% GST of INR 36,000 implies a subtotal of INR 200,000 and a total of INR 236,000, whereas the invoice total is INR 246,000 (an 18% tax on the implied subtotal of INR 210,000 would be INR 37,800).
